title: This looks disorganized / not consistent and also don't need to show impl [image 1]

items.content: Data: 'implement'/'impl' after a plan starts the plan build; mark build requests; harness notices resume the agent's last task instead of a new 'Harness notice:' task

UI: consistent indentation (each child one level under its parent), hide the build request row (plan header stands for it), nest its subtasks under the plan todo they do, agent names only in project scope
Gate (fmt, clippy, tests for aura-app + aura-ui-terminal) and commit

summary: Core logic is in. The remaining work is test updates and new tests; I'll hand that off in a tighter scope.
